## Entries removed during this pass

### `cve2026`

CVE-2026-31873 was cited as a Tyk API Gateway quota race. Both the MITRE CVE Services record and NVD show that identifier belongs to an unrelated Unhead URI-scheme sanitization bypass. The citation was wrong and is removed; the B0 baseline is supported by CWE-807 and Kettle instead.

### `practice`

An unattributed 'industry metering guidance' entry with no retrievable source. Removed rather than dressed up with a URL found after the fact.
